page.metaDescription: Help for BCSentinel users and administrators in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
page.title: Find the right BCSentinel guidance quickly.
page.lead: This page brings together the most important onboarding, product, and troubleshooting topics for users and Business Central administrators.

heroAside.title: New to BCSentinel?
heroAside.text: Start with registration, connection testing, and the free scan.

heroAside.title: Technical issue?
heroAside.text: Review documentation and troubleshooting first, then use the support channel.

heroAside.title: Product access
heroAside.text: Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring are activated directly from Business Central.

sections.title: From setup to the first result
sections.lead: The recommended flow remains intentionally lightweight.

cards.title: 1. Register the tenant
cards.text: Open BCSentinel in Business Central, confirm data processing, and register tenant, environment, and company.

cards.title: 2. Test the connection
cards.text: Validate API configuration and access through the integrated connection test.

cards.title: 3. Start the free scan
cards.text: Run the first scan and review the limited preview of results, findings, actions, and report.

sections.title: Which access fits each step?
sections.lead: The products form one journey but grant different rights.

cards.title: Assessment
cards.text: Unlocks the already generated complete analysis for seven days. No additional scan credit.

cards.title: Validation
cards.text: Includes one new scan credit followed by another seven days of full access.

cards.title: Monitoring
cards.text: Adds scheduled scans, history, trends, exceptions, and ongoing full access during the active term.

sections.title: Findings, Estimated Loss, and Executive Report
sections.lead: BCSentinel connects technical data issues with business relevance.

cards.title: Findings
cards.text: Severity, affected records, status, and recommendations support prioritization.

cards.title: Estimated Loss
cards.text: Measured values and model assumptions are shown separately. The calculation is a decision-support value, not a cost guarantee.

cards.title: Executive Report
cards.text: The report summarizes Health Score, business impact, priorities, and next steps for management.

sections.title: Check common causes first
sections.lead: Many issues can be resolved directly in setup or through the documentation.

cards.title: No results visible
cards.text: Check scan status, wait for completion, then refresh license and result access.

cards.title: Incomplete access
cards.text: Refresh product status and the access snapshot. Assessment and Validation are time-limited.

cards.title: Connection failed
cards.text: Check API URL, token, tenant context, and HTTPS availability.

sections.title: Still unresolved?
sections.lead: Send a support request with as much concrete context as possible.

cards.title: Documentation
cards.text: Detailed steps for setup, scans, products, and troubleshooting.

cards.title: Support
cards.text: For concrete technical incidents, access issues, or pilot onboarding.

cards.title: Contact
cards.text: For demos, product questions, partnership, or general enquiries.
